ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job: Chorus Snake wins turn-1 fights, Barnstormer and the Prompter's Boy start real growth, and three Tier 6 capstones give each build a place to land; placement decides the power.
ratings_why.distinct: Encore, Death Scene and the Prompter's Boy read as Reborn, Deathrattle and Rivendare; Understudy stepping into gaps and the lobby-wide Notices bank are the fresh parts.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; the hot stacks are high rolls for the owner to tune, and more passes would mostly reshuffle numbers.

points.text: The Repertory's peak (Dame Natrix in front of the Prompter's Boy, with Encore, Old Crest and Sir Hesketh) can fire one +1/+1-to-all scene seven or more times a fight. That's a great chase, but it's the first thing to sim.

Notices grow faster each fight on an Encore board, and the Bill-Poster pays per 10 of them every turn, so its output climbs late rather than staying flat. A fine late curve; just check where it sits at 80-100 Notices.
Say whether a sold unit counts as 'in front of' the Prompter's Boy for Madame Coronella's trigger; I'd say yes, using the slot it was sold from.

The Green-Room Snake's +2/+2 only arrives when a front unit dies for good, which Encore makes later, so the early wings build is slow. A small Start of Combat gain while it waits behind someone would keep it growing.
Mr Grey destroying an Encore unit at Start of Combat is a free Death Scene, a Notice and a return. That's a nice self-harm line worth showing in the builds.

standouts.why: A positional multiplier that works in fights and in the shop, so where you put the leads really matters.
Dying last pays for the whole cast, which makes for a clear and exciting back-corner capstone.
A 2/1 with Encore is the right Tier 1 tempo body and stays useful as Berus and Claque fodder.

weakest.why: A flat 1 gold on an easy condition; it's fine but adds no decisions.
It grows only when a lead dies for good, which Encore delays, so it does little before Tier 4.
In-fight only and modest; it's filler unless the wall build is fully assembled.

flags.note: Natrix in front of the Prompter's Boy with Encore, Hesketh and Old Crest multiplies a board-wide permanent buff; golden Prompter and golden Hesketh push it further.
Pays per 10 Notices every turn while Notices grow faster each fight, so total growth is quadratic late.
Reads lifetime Notices, so it swings a lot with lobby fodder (Eggs, Oozes) and with Encore-heavy boards.
Rehearser on Natrix in front of the Prompter's Boy is +2/+2 to the whole board in the shop for 3 gold; it's bounded by copies, but cheap.
